modules.title: Speaking — 50 More MET Prompts
modules.sourceNote: 10 prompt sets × 5 tasks (picture description, personal question, preference, advantages/disadvantages, roleplay/persuasion). 60s for tasks 1-3, 90s for tasks 4-5.

exercises.prompt: Describe this picture: a farmers market with stalls of fresh fruit and vegetables, vendors talking to customers, baskets of produce, and people carrying bags.
Tell us about the last time you bought something at a market or street fair.
Some people prefer to buy food at farmers markets, while others prefer supermarkets. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about growing their own vegetables at home to save money. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering closing the main square on weekends to hold a farmers market. Some drivers are against losing parking spaces. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a birthday party with children playing games, a table with a cake and balloons, parents talking in the background, and presents on a chair.
Tell us about the most memorable birthday or celebration you have had.
Some people prefer small celebrations with close friends, while others prefer big parties. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about spending a large amount of money on an extravagant birthday party. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your child's school is considering banning birthday celebrations with food in classrooms because of allergy risks. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think of this proposal and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a dental office with a patient in a chair, a dentist wearing a mask and gloves, equipment with lights, and a poster about brushing teeth.
Tell us about a time you visited a dentist or doctor for a check-up.
Some people go to the dentist only when something hurts, while others go for regular check-ups. Which approach do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about getting their teeth whitened at an expensive clinic. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering adding free dental check-ups for children in public schools. Some people say the money should go to other services. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a campsite in a forest with two tents, a family sitting around a campfire, a pot over the fire, and trees and mountains in the background.
Tell us about the last time you spent a night away from home.
Some people love camping in nature, while others prefer staying in hotels. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about a camping trip in a remote area without any previous experience. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

A national park in your country is considering limiting the number of visitors per day to protect nature. I am the park director. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a garden with an older woman planting flowers, tools on the ground, a watering can, and rows of vegetables.
Tell us about a time you grew a plant or took care of a garden.
Some people find gardening relaxing, while others consider it boring and tiring work. Which view do you agree with, and why?
A city is considering turning empty lots into community gardens where residents can grow food. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your neighborhood association is proposing that every house replace part of its lawn with trees and plants to reduce heat. I am a member of the association. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a zoo with visitors watching giraffes, a child pointing excitedly, a guide with a group, and information signs near the fence.
Tell us about the last time you visited a zoo or aquarium.
Some people believe zoos help protect animals, while others believe they should not exist. Which view do you agree with, and why?
A city is considering building a large modern zoo with natural habitats instead of cages. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering closing the old zoo and releasing the animals into sanctuaries. Some families are against losing the attraction. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a barber shop with a customer in a chair, a barber cutting hair with scissors, mirrors on the walls, and another customer waiting and reading a magazine.
Tell us about a time you had a haircut you really liked or really disliked.
Some people change their hairstyle often, while others keep the same style for years. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about cutting their own hair at home to save money. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering offering free haircut vouchers to unemployed people. Some taxpayers think the money should be spent elsewhere. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a living room where a group of friends is playing a board game, dice on the table, snacks and drinks nearby, and one person laughing while another thinks carefully.
Tell us about the last time you played a game with friends or family.
Some people prefer playing games on screens, while others prefer physical board games. Which do you prefer, and why?
A school is considering adding a weekly board game afternoon to develop students' social skills. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your child's school is considering banning all games during breaks, including traditional games, to avoid conflicts between students. I am the school principal. Tell me what you think of this proposal and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: a busy street at night with food carts, a vendor cooking behind a grill, steam rising, customers waiting in line, and colorful lights.
Tell us about the best or worst street food you have ever eaten.
Some people love trying street food when traveling, while others avoid it completely. Which do you prefer, and why?
A friend is thinking about leaving their office job to run a food truck. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering banning street food vendors from the historic center to keep the area clean. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
Describe this picture: an outdoor wedding with a couple exchanging vows, guests seated on white chairs, flowers along an aisle, and a photographer taking pictures.
Tell us about the most special celebration you have ever attended.
Some people prefer big traditional weddings, while others prefer small simple ceremonies. Which do you prefer, and why?
A couple is thinking about taking a loan to pay for a large wedding. What are the advantages and disadvantages of this idea?

Your city is considering creating a free public program that helps couples plan simple low-cost weddings. Some people say the city should not spend money on this. I am a member of the city council. Tell me what you think of this plan and convince me to agree with you.
